role: A one-shot prospective confirmation gate on the first still-unopened eligible BLASTNet condition after Cases 3, 4, 6, and 5. It tests the already fixed deterministic observation-only Low-64 plus geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K11 control discovered on opened Case 5. Case 2 is outside all PoolFire fit and development data and was not used to select the Low-64 representation, depth, solver, metrics, or thresholds. A pass is evidence on one additional condition within the already used BLASTNet vitiated-H2-air family only; it is not broad external-family generalization, a learned algorithm, a wall/RSS result, curved-ray validation, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
scientific_question: With no fitting, adaptation, depth search, regularization, clipping, fallback, or threshold change after Case 2 opening, does the fixed unregularized Low-64 observation proxy followed by unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K11 preserve an independently adequate zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 reference on every frame and every one of the thirteen frozen all-nine virtual rigs while using 12A+11A^T rather than 16A+16A^T, and can any equal-or-cheaper deterministic control explain the result?

result_before_opening_audit.selection_rule: Use the first still-unopened eligible condition in the v75 projected-density-byte and case-ID ordering after the consumed Case 3 sentinel, fixed Case 4/6 expansion, and Case 5 gate.

selected_public_dataset.description: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 2
selected_public_dataset.boundary_conditions: inflow and outflow in source x, periodic in source y and z

acquisition_and_opening_contract.download_scope: Only Kaggle info.json, X/Y/Z grids, and all 55 RHO files. Velocity, pressure, temperature, and species files are forbidden.
open_release_must_bind: tracked clean source commit and source closure
all 59 file paths, sizes, and SHA256 values
Kaggle dataset identity, version, listing identity, and signed source-object identities
the acquisition validator, numeric opener, formal runner, and independent scientific validator hashes
the frozen v209 geometry contract and independently sealed v218.1 Low-64 K11 evidence
the Low-64 basis, Moore-Penrose rule, K11 candidate, K16 reference, controls, metrics, thresholds, call ledgers, and decision strings

frozen_preprocessing.source_grid: Read each full X/Y/Z grid as little-endian float32 and reshape C-order to 1152x128x128.
frozen_preprocessing.rectilinear_verification: Derive x=X[:,0,0], y=Y[0,:,0], z=Z[0,0,:]; require each full grid to equal its broadcast axis within 8*float32-epsilon*max(axis_abs,1), require finite strictly monotone axes, and reverse both coordinate and density axes when decreasing.
frozen_preprocessing.source_density: Read each RHO file as little-endian float32, reshape C-order to 1152x128x128, and require finite strictly positive values.
frozen_preprocessing.spatial_selection: Use the complete verified source-coordinate bounding box; no truth-dependent crop, registration, flame-front tracking, temporal exclusion, or manual ROI.
frozen_preprocessing.target_coordinate_rule: Float64 linspace including every verified source-axis endpoint, followed by deterministic float64 trilinear interpolation with bounds_error=true and no extrapolation.
frozen_preprocessing.support: Apply the same one-voxel outer-boundary zero support as v207-v218.1.
frozen_preprocessing.gauge: Subtract the spatial mean over the supported interior before restoring the zero support boundary.

frozen_geometry.camera_selection: For each frozen v209 rig, use exactly the first nine stable camera IDs in its already frozen twelve-camera order.
frozen_geometry.camera_permutation_rule: Reverse labeled camera blocks, rebuild the geometry in reversed order, restore outputs by stable camera ID, and require observation, proxy field, K11 field, residual, and all metrics to agree within the frozen independent tolerances.

fixed_low64_observation_proxy.raw_span: The tensor products sin(pi*i*z) sin(pi*j*y) sin(pi*k*x) for i,j,k in {1,2,3,4} on normalized voxel coordinates, with one-voxel zero support and supported-interior zero-mean gauge.
fixed_low64_observation_proxy.formal_basis: Economy QR of the 8192x64 raw span followed by deterministic maximum-absolute-pivot positive signs.
fixed_low64_observation_proxy.independent_basis: A separate implementation must construct the same physical span through an SVD-based orthonormal basis; comparisons are on physical fields and responses, not basis-coordinate signs.
fixed_low64_observation_proxy.geometry_response: For each rig, apply the exact reported straight-ray operator to all 64 fixed basis fields to form M with shape observation_length x 64. This is a geometry-only offline cache and may not read Case 2 density.
allowed_online_inputs: current Case 2 synthetic two-component observation y
current reported geometry and fixed Low-64 response M
fixed_low64_observation_proxy.coefficient_estimate: Compute economy SVD M=U diag(s) V^T; tau=float64_epsilon*max(M.shape)*s_max; require all 64 singular values exceed tau; set c_hat=V diag(1/s) U^T y.
fixed_low64_observation_proxy.initializer_field: x0=c_hat times the fixed physical basis, with no additional normalization, clipping, shift, or truth-dependent gauge.

solver_and_arms.solver: Unmodified strict_pcgls_v10_1 recurrence with denominator floor 1e-30 and exact geometry-only Jacobi preconditioner using relative floor 1e-6 and median-positive normalization.
solver_and_arms.normalized_bp_rule: Use x0=A^T y * <A A^T y,y>/max(||A A^T y||^2,1e-30), cache A x0 as the initial projection, then run the specified unchanged recurrence.
solver_and_arms.control_dominance: Any non-equivalent control that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate with componentwise equal-or-lower exact A/A^T calls blocks a Low-64-specific advantage claim.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must independently validate the 59 acquired objects, consume no second opening release, parse all raw Case 2 grids and densities, reproduce rectilinear preprocessing, construct an SVD-based Low-64 physical span, rebuild all thirteen rigs and exact observations, solve the observation proxy without importing the formal proxy helper, run separate CGLS and PCGLS recurrences, reconstruct every arm, metric, rig tail, permutation audit, and exact-call ledger, and verify all formal and input trees unchanged.

decision_order: Any acquisition, opening, source, input, roster, preprocessing, finite, rank, permutation, solver, call-ledger, formal-independent, seal, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE2_LOW64_K11_EXTERNAL_V219.

If zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 fails any absolute cell or complete-rig gate, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_INADEQUATE_CASE2_K16_REFERENCE_V219 and do not interpret the candidate or controls as pass or fail.

If the K16 reference is adequate but fixed Low-64 PCGLS K11 fails any absolute or K16-matched gate, conclude FAIL_CASE2_LOW64_K11_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION_V219 and close this fixed K11 mechanism without trying another depth, inverse, basis, regularizer, threshold, or model.
If fixed Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes but an equal-or-cheaper non-equivalent control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE2_DETERMINISTIC_HEADROOM_BUT_LOW64_CONTROL_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V219.

Only if the K16 reference is adequate, fixed Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes all 715 cells and 13 rigs, exact calls are 12A+11A^T, and no equal-or-cheaper control passes may conclude PASS_CASE2_LOW64_K11_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION_V219.

Any positive result is one additional previously unopened same-family public condition only. It may authorize a separately frozen fresh wall/RSS gate, but it cannot by itself establish learning, broad generalization, resource speedup, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: Do not tune Low-64 modes, rank, inverse, singular threshold, PCGLS depth, Jacobi floor, controls, metrics, thresholds, preprocessing, or geometry after Case 2 numeric opening. Do not substitute Case 12 or rescue a valid failure with CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, extra exact calls, or GPU training.
